note: Eight native PNGs per app locale. Localized demonstration data and original illustrative photo. Progress shows a real OpenFreeMap basemap with attributed MapLibre rendering and synthetic private GPX geometry; no real recorded walk, purchase or field-reviewed route is implied. Prepared locally; console uploads are tracked separately.

requirements.headline: Remember Every Walk
requirements.feature: Private journal with notes, ratings and favourites

requirements.headline: Record Your Time Outdoors
requirements.feature: Explicit start, pause and finish; estimated distance only where supported

requirements.headline: Bring Your Own Route
requirements.feature: Private GPX import and geometry preview; no basemap claim

requirements.headline: Follow Your Imported Geometry
requirements.feature: Location progress on compatible devices; no turn-by-turn claim

requirements.headline: Share Your Walking Plan
requirements.feature: User-initiated system share sheet; no emergency-monitoring claim

requirements.headline: Make TrailNest Yours
requirements.feature: Language, units, light and dark appearance

visualReview.scope: All 22 eight-scene contact sheets; original Spanish progress PNG checked at full resolution. Composition, localized UI, RTL, labels, illustrative data and privacy reviewed. Automated capture found zero text overflow.
